name: Stitches
summary: Along Duskwood's western road, Stitches marches toward Darkshire, crushing the Night Watch and unwary travelers in his path.

sections.title: The Terror of the Main Road
sections.body: Near Abercrombie's shack, northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery, Stitches sets out east along the road toward Darkshire. Unholy sorcery and harvested corpses made the undead abomination, whose immense strength and malice overwhelm the Night Watch checkpoints. He tears through the defense camp across from Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and the outpost outside the Rotting Orchard, slaughtering travelers and town defenders along the way.

sections.title: The Embalmer's Twisted Revenge
sections.body: Abercrombie, known to passersby as a harmless hermit, harbored a deep grudge against Lord Ello Ebonlocke, Darkshire's mayor. Under innocent guises, he relied on unsuspecting adventurers to gather occult reagents, tools, and materials, then completed his horrific creation. Abercrombie sent Stitches to Darkshire as a mocking gift, intending to break the town's defenses and punish Lord Ebonlocke.

faq.answer: Stitches was assembled in Duskwood through necromancy. Who made him remains part of the mystery surrounding the undead near Raven Hill.

faq.q: Why is Stitches marching toward Darkshire?
faq.answer: Stitches marches along Duskwood's main road toward Darkshire, attacking the Night Watch and anyone else in his path. The reason for his attack emerges during the local investigation.

faq.q: Can the Night Watch stop Stitches on their own?
faq.answer: No. Left alone, Stitches easily overwhelms and decimates the Night Watch checkpoints outside Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and the Rotting Orchard, then reaches Darkshire's gates. Concerted militia defense and traveling adventurers are needed to bring him down.
Stitches appears behind Abercrombie's shack, along the road northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery, then begins his long, deadly march east across Duskwood.

angles.text: Stitches threatens Darkshire's beleaguered citizens and turns Duskwood's high road into a deadly gauntlet for fresh Alliance recruits.
As a grotesque product of necromancy and profane flesh-crafting, Stitches embodies what the Holy Light is called upon to purge.
